text: UK GDP contracts 0.1% over three months, missing flat-growth expectations. Services stall while construction and production decline. The miss exposes constrained momentum ahead of fiscal adjustment, with limited directional movement and policy flexibility compressed.

meta.note: Collapse not confirmed; included as boundary pressure rather than realized break.

text: An executive action is expected to reclassify marijuana at the federal level, easing restrictions and altering tax and banking treatment. Market prices react sharply, revealing dormant sector capacity as regulatory posture reverses.

meta.note: Return contingent on execution timing; currently signaled rather than finalized.
